biography.plain_text: Oleg Paltin is an energy entrepreneur associated with Switzerland's Holt Global group. He owned its earlier international trading business, dealing in oil and related feedstocks. The group combines sourcing and supply with delivery logistics, and its sustainability arm, Pact Capital, helps industrial customers meet obligations in regulated carbon emissions markets.

long_biography.plain_text:
Oleg Paltin founded EMPALA to introduce electric motorcycles into delivery fleets in the United Arab Emirates. Working with the Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure, his team invested in a bike designed around local operating requirements. The venture brought vehicle development together with the infrastructure needed to keep delivery riders working.

An agreement with EMX, the logistics arm of 7X, targeted the final stage of parcel delivery. Paltin also signed a collaboration with the Abu Dhabi Investment Office covering charging, battery swaps and digital fleet management. The plans included exploring local manufacturing, extending the project beyond vehicle supply.
